findings.claim: the dry-run test checks only the printed text, so it passes when the dry run deletes the backups
findings.suggestion: After the dry run, assert that all seven backups are still in the folder.

findings.claim: the pattern test passes the default glob, so it stays green when --pattern is ignored
findings.suggestion: Use a pattern the default doesn't match, such as *.tgz, with files of both kinds.

findings.claim: backups gives each suffix the same days, so a .txt and a .tar.gz of one day share an mtime and their order is undefined
findings.suggestion: Let backups take a start day, so each call's files get their own times.
